The '''Volgastani-Hanovkayan War''' was a conflict listed in the old source as lasting from 1989 to 1998. This 1994-back draft covers only the pre-1995 phase.

== Source Basis ==

The extracted [[List of Wars]] gives the title and full span but does not provide a dedicated conflict article. The title identifies [[Volgastan Baathist Republic|Volgastan]] as one side.

== 1994-Back Interpretation ==

Because the war began in 1989, it belongs to the late Istragarde-era conflict environment. It may overlap with the [[Volgastani Expansionist Doctrine]], which the treaty source describes as a series of Volgastani territorial expansions through the 1980s and 1990s.

== Source Limits ==

This draft does not settle the 1998 ending, post-1994 campaigns, opposing state identity, casualties, or territorial outcome. Those details need a later post-1994 war pass.
